title: A hot tip to battle performance anxiety? 'Pretend flush' a mistake down the toilet
summary: Worried about stumbling before a high-stakes event, like a race or a job interview? Psychologist Cindra Kamphoff offers creative strategies to overcome the jitters and build confidence in the moment.
